summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests a myeloablative allogeneic stem cell transplant from a related or unrelated donor for blood and bone marrow diseases, including leukemia, lymphoma, myelodysplasia and multiple myeloma. Before transplant, patients receive total body irradiation, or busulfan and fludarabine, from Day -5 to Day -2, with the transplant on Day 0; cyclophosphamide is given on Days +3 and +4, tacrolimus starts on Day +5 and is tapered until Day +100, and mycophenolate mofetil is given through Day +35 or 7 days after engraftment, whichever is later. The record does not state a main outcome measure, and the study is listed as Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa un trasplante alogénico de células madre mieloablativo de un donante relacionado o no relacionado, para enfermedades de la sangre y la médula ósea, incluidas leucemia, linfoma, mielodisplasia y mieloma múltiple. Antes del trasplante, los pacientes reciben irradiación corporal total, o busulfán y fludarabina, del Día -5 al Día -2, con el trasplante en el Día 0; la ciclofosfamida se administra los Días +3 y +4, el tacrolimus comienza el Día +5 y se reduce gradualmente hasta el Día +100, y el micofenolato de mofetilo se administra hasta el Día +35 o 7 días después del injerto, lo que ocurra más tarde. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal, y el estudio figura como de fase 2.
who_for: Karnofsky score of at least 70% or Lansky play score of at least 70
Adequate kidney, liver, lung and heart function as defined in the record
Disease in a remission or stage listed in the disease-specific criteria
Voluntary written consent from the patient or legal representative
not_for: Active HIV infection or known HIV positive serology
Chronic myelogenous leukemia in blast crisis
Evidence of progressive disease on imaging or biopsy
